question: A 1-year-old boy, who did not pass the tests of auditory screening at birth and who has auditory brainstem evoked potentials that determine bilateral mild-moderate hearing loss in the right ear and moderate-severe hearing loss in the left ear. What is the most correct attitude to follow at the present time?

options.opa: Perform an audiometry within 6 months to confirm the diagnosis.
options.opb: Surgery to adapt a cochlear implant in the right ear.
options.opc: Wait until 3 years to check if you develop the language.
options.opd: Adaptation of bilateral hearing prosthesis and logopedic rehabilitation.
options.ope: Surgery to adapt a cochlear implant in the left ear.
